lessons.title: There is a problem

items.example: Tem um problema com o meu quarto.
items.exampleMeaning: There is a problem with my room.
There is a towel in the bathroom.
There is water in the fridge.
There is food in the restaurant.

items.example: Não tem luz no meu quarto.
items.exampleMeaning: There is no light in my room.

items.text: tem um problema com o ar-condicionado
items.meaning: there is a problem with the air conditioning
items.example: Tem um problema com o ar-condicionado.
items.exampleMeaning: There is a problem with the air conditioning.

lessons.tip: Use 'tem' to say 'there is' or 'there are' in Brazilian Portuguese. It is used for singular and plural.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Tem um problema com o seu quarto?
dialogue.meaning: Is there a problem with your room?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sim, tem um problema com o ar-condicionado.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, there is a problem with the air conditioning.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Desculpe! O que mais tem?
dialogue.meaning: Sorry! What else is there?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Não tem luz no meu quarto.
dialogue.meaning: There is no light in my room.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Entendi. Tem uma toalha?
dialogue.meaning: I understand. Is there a towel?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sim, tem uma toalha no banheiro.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, there is a towel in the bathroom.

scenario.brief: You are at the hotel reception. You need to report a problem with your room. Ask about the towel as well.
scenario.goal: You should explain the issues with your room.

lessons.title: Polite requests

items.example: Pode me ajudar com a chave?
items.exampleMeaning: Can you help me with the key?
Can you bring more towels?
Can you check if there is water?
Can you change the bed?

items.example: Pode falar mais devagar, por favor?
items.exampleMeaning: Can you speak slower, please?
Can you show me the restaurant?

lessons.tip: To make polite requests, use 'pode' followed by the verb. This is a common way to ask for help.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Pode me ajudar com a chave?
dialogue.meaning: Can you help me with the key?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Claro! O que aconteceu?
dialogue.meaning: Of course! What happened?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: O meu quarto não abre.
dialogue.meaning: My room does not open.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Pode verificar se tem água?
dialogue.meaning: Can you check if there is water?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sim, claro! Pode trazer mais toalhas?
dialogue.meaning: Yes, of course! Can you bring more towels?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sim, eu vou trazer agora.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I will bring them now.

scenario.brief: You are at the hotel. You need help with your key and want to request more towels. Ask politely.
scenario.goal: You should make polite requests for assistance.

lessons.title: Reporting a problem

items.example: Tem um problema com a água.
items.exampleMeaning: There is a problem with the water.
The air conditioning does not work.
The elevator is broken.
The room is not clean.
There is no room service.

items.example: O restaurante não está disponível agora.
items.exampleMeaning: The restaurant is not available now.

lessons.tip: When reporting a problem, use 'tem um problema com...' to explain the issue. Be clear and direct.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Tem um problema com a água?
dialogue.meaning: Is there a problem with the water?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sim, a água não funciona.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, the water does not work.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Desculpe! O que mais está quebrado?
dialogue.meaning: Sorry! What else is broken?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: O elevador está quebrado.
dialogue.meaning: The elevator is broken.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Entendi. O quarto está limpo?
dialogue.meaning: I understand. Is the room clean?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Não, o quarto não está limpo.
dialogue.meaning: No, the room is not clean.

scenario.brief: You are speaking with the hotel manager. Report problems with the water and the elevator and ask about the cleanliness of your room.
scenario.goal: You should clearly report the issues you are facing.

lessons.title: Asking for assistance

items.example: Preciso de ajuda com a chave.
items.exampleMeaning: I need help with the key.

items.example: Pode falar com alguém sobre o problema?
items.exampleMeaning: Can you talk to someone about the problem?
Where can I find the restaurant?
Where is the pool?
Is there someone available to help?

items.meaning: can I talk to the manager?
items.example: Posso falar com o gerente, por favor?
items.exampleMeaning: Can I talk to the manager, please?

lessons.tip: Use 'preciso de ajuda' to express that you need help. This is a direct way to ask for assistance.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Preciso de ajuda com a chave.
dialogue.meaning: I need help with the key.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Claro! Onde posso encontrar o gerente?
dialogue.meaning: Sure! Where can I find the manager?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Pode falar com alguém sobre o problema?
dialogue.meaning: Can you talk to someone about the problem?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sim, tem alguém disponível agora.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, there is someone available now.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Onde fica a piscina?
dialogue.meaning: Where is the pool?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: A piscina fica no primeiro andar.
dialogue.meaning: The pool is on the first floor.

scenario.brief: You are at the hotel and need help with your key. Ask about the manager and find out where the pool is.
scenario.goal: You should ask for assistance and get the information you need.

review.title: Review of Chapter 7: At the hotel

dialogue.meaning: Is there a problem with my room?

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Pode me ajudar a resolver isso?
dialogue.meaning: Can you help me solve this?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Claro! O que mais está errado?
dialogue.meaning: Of course! What else is wrong?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: O ar-condicionado não funciona.
dialogue.meaning: The air conditioning does not work.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Desculpe! Vou chamar alguém.
dialogue.meaning: Sorry! I will call someone.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Onde posso encontrar o restaurante?
dialogue.meaning: Where can I find the restaurant?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: O restaurante fica no primeiro andar.
dialogue.meaning: The restaurant is on the first floor.

scenario.brief: You are discussing issues with the hotel staff. Report problems and ask for help.
scenario.goal: You should effectively communicate your needs.
